english: Bow before Siva's offering to Twilight, The water held in his cupped hand. Reflecting Gauris moonlike face, Now flushed with jealous anger, It looks more like a crimson lotus
prakrit: पसुवइणो रोसारुणपडिमासंकंतगोरिमुहअंदम्,गहिअग्घपंकअं मिअ संझासलिलंजलिं णमह

english: Shame on those who cannot appreciate This ambrosial Prakrit poetry But pore instead Over treatises on love
prakrit: अमिअं पाउअकव्वं पढिउं सोउं च जे ण आणंति,कामस्स तत्ततत्तिं कुणंति ते कह ण लज्जंति

english: Among countless elegant poems, King Hala, patron of poets, Has selected seven hundred.
prakrit: सत्त सआइं कइवच्छलेण कोडीअ मज्झआरम्मि,हालेण विरइआइं सालंकाराण गाहाणं

english: Look at that heron Standing absolutely motionless On the lotus leaf. It is just like mother of pearl In a setting of spotless emerald.
prakrit: उअ णिच्चलणिप्पंदा भिसिणीवत्तम्मि रेहइ वलाआ,निम्मलमरगअभाअणपरिट्ठिआ संखसुत्ति व्व

english: While making love, women go on enticing men Up to the very end When their eyes, Long and oval like the petals of the waterlily, Close
prakrit: ताव च्चिअ रइसमए महिलाणं विब्भमा विराअंति,जाव ण कुवलअदलसच्छहाइ मउलंति णअणाइं

english: Look, mother-in-law! That lovely mass of lotuses Used to be the most beautiful thing in our village, But now winter has made them look Like a sesame field just after harvest
prakrit: अत्ता तह रमणिज्जं अंहं गामस्स मंडणीहूअं,लुअतिलवाडिसरिच्छं सिसिरेणकअं भिसिणिसंडं

english: Cheer up! Don't cry for the paddy turning white. There's the field of hemp in bloom Like a dancer with her face painted yellow!
prakrit: किं रुअसि ओणअमुही धवलाअंतेसु सालिछेत्तेसु,हरिआलमंडिअमुही णडि व्व सणवाडिआ जाआ

english: Friend, this is just the way things happen— Stop your tears, don't turn your face away— Like the tendrils of a young cucumber, One's affections twine around an object That does not stay.
prakrit: सहि एरिसि च्चिअ गई मा रुव्वसु तंसवलिअमुहअंदं,एआण वालवालुंकितंतुकुडिलाण पेम्माणं

english: When their little son Climbed on her husband's back As he knelt at her feet, She could not help laughing Despite her fierce anger.
prakrit: पाअपडिअस्स पइणो पुट्ठिं पुत्ते समारुहंतम्मि,दढमण्णुदूमिआइ विहासो घरिणीअ णिक्कंतो

english: Don't get annoyed: There's nothing wrong with your cooking. That the fire won't burn but only smokes Is because it wants to inhale your breath That has the fragrance of red trumpetflowers.
prakrit: रंधणकम्मणिउणिए मा जूरसु रत्तपाडलसुअंधं,मुहमारुअं पिअंतो धूमाइ सिही ण पज्जलइ

english: The husband laughed at his wife's face Which, smudged with soot That stuck to her hand from kitchen work, Looked more than ever like the moon.
prakrit: घरिणीअ महाणसकम्मलग्गमसिमइलिएण हत्थेण,छित्तं मुहं हसिज्जइ चंदावत्थं गअं पइणा

english: When her friends asked the young wife Who was pregnant for the first time What she craved most She simply looked at her husband
prakrit: किं किं दे पडिहासइ सहीहि इअ पुच्छिआइ मुद्धाए,पढमुग्गअदोहलिणीअ णवर दइअं गआ दिट्ठी

english: Sweet moon, Crest jewel of the sky, Beauty spot on the face of night, Touch me with the very same rays With which you've touched my most dearly beloved.
prakrit: अमअमअ गअणसेहर रअणीमुखतिलअ चंद दे छिवसु,छित्तो जेहि जिअअमो ममं पि तेहिं चिअ करेहिं

english: First let my dear husband come home, Then let me give him a scolding, And then let him do his best to bring me round. There must be someone who can get all three wishes.
prakrit: एहिज्ज सो पउत्थो अहअं कुप्पेज्ज सो वि अणुणेज्ज,इअ कस्स वि फलइ मणोरमाण माला पिअअमम्मि

english: Young calf, Blushing red as a tender mango shoot, Running with ears pricked Towards the house of your desire, Assume the cool whiteness of a bull!
prakrit: कोसंवकिसलवण्णअ तण्णअ उण्णामिएहि कण्णेहिं,हिअअट्ठिअं घरं वच्चमाण धवलत्तणं पाव

english: Dearest, I know you are not really asleep, Just keeping your eyes closed. I can see goose pimples rising as I kiss your cheek. I won't be late again.
prakrit: अलिअपसुत्तअ विणिमीलिअच्छ दे सुहअ मज्झ ओआसं,गंडपरिउं वणापुलइअंग ण पुणो चिराइस्सं

english: Don't bother about your makeup, girl, Just go to him quickly, while he wants you. Once his longing is over He won't give you a thought.
prakrit: असमत्त मंडण च्चिअ वच्च घरं से सकोउहल्लस्स,वोलाविअहलहलअस्स पुत्ति चित्ते ण लग्गिहिसि

english: I will never forget how, When her face was smeared with red ghee, We kissed, Carefully pouting our lips So that our noses and foreheads Wouldn't meet.
prakrit: आअरपणामिओट्टं अघडिअणासं असंहअणिडालं,वण्णघिअलित्तमुहिए तीए परिउंवणं भरिमो

english: I refuse to believe that she who, Cheeks flushed with excitement, Is so demanding while making love Can really suit him, However meek she may be next mornin
prakrit: आणासआइ देंती तह सुरए हरिसविअसिअकवोला,गोसे वि ओणअमुही अह से त्ति पिअं ण सद्धहिमो

english: Being separated from what is dear And being forced to look at what isn't Are two causes of grief. I bow to your good breeding Which demands that you act as you do.
prakrit: पिअविरहो अप्पिअदंसणं च गरुआइ दो वि दुक्खाइ,जीअ तुमं कारिज्जसि तीअ णमो आहिजाईए

english: You would not be so touchy If you knew the pain of falling asleep beside one's lover And waking up in the middle of the night To discover that the bed is empty.
prakrit: ण कुणंतो च्चिअ माणं णिसासु सुहसुत्तदरविवुद्धानं,सुण्णइअपासपरिमुसणवेअणं जइ सि जानंतो

english: At whichever part of her body Her husband's younger brother Aims the tender twig Gooseflesh raises a palisade of sticks.
prakrit: णवलइपहरं अंगे जहिं जहिं महइ देअरो दाउं,रोमंच दंदराई तहिं तहिं दीसइ वहूए

english: Today, As I think of the pleasures I've had Without him, The thunder of the first rain clouds Sounds like the executioner's drum.
prakrit: अज्ज मए तेण विणा अणुहूअसुहाइ संभरंतीए,अहिणवमेहाण रवो णिसामिओ वज्झपडतो व्व

english: Headman's son, How heartless you are! Shying away from your wife You rarely show yourself, Like a worm in a neem berry. Yet because of you The whole village is pining away.
prakrit: णिक्किव जाआभीरुअ दुद्दंसण णिंवकीडसारिच्छ,गामो गामणिणंदण तुज्झ कए तह वितणुआइ

english: Lying on his breast, Rough with the scars of many a wound, The headman's wife finds it difficult to rest, But his village sleeps sound.
prakrit: पहरवणमग्गविसमे जाआ किच्छेण लहइ से णिद्दं,गामणिउत्तस्स उरे पल्ली उण से सुहं सुअइ

english: What good old-fashioned honesty! But really, my dear, You're the only one who goes in for it. Nowadays people think one thing and say another.
prakrit: अह संभाविअमग्गो सुहअ तुए च्चेअ णवर णिव्वूढो,एण्हिं हिअए अण्णं अण्णं वाआइ लोअस्स

english: What do you think you are doing, Embracing me from behind? First you set fire to my heart And then you start burning my back With these hot sighs of remorse.
prakrit: उण्हाइ णीससंतो कीस मह परंमुहीअ सअणद्धे,हिअअं पलीविउं अणुसएण पुट्ठिं पलीवेसि

english: The good wife takes all day To explain to her importunate young brother-in-law The paintings on the walls of their house That depict the adventures of LaksmanRamas devoted younger brother.
prakrit: दिअरस्स असुद्धमणस्स कुलवहूणिअअकुड्डलिहिआइ,दिअहं कहेइ रामाणुलग्गसोमित्तिचरिआइं

english: Young and attractive and her husband abroad, Living in poverty at a busy crossroad, With loose women in the neighborhood, —You're not telling me she's still chaste?
prakrit: चत्तरघरिणी पिअदंसणा अ तरुणी पउत्थवइआअ,असई सअज्जिआदुग्गआ अ णह खंडिअं सीलं

english: Protecting the self-image of her husband, Who is poor but proud of his breeding, The wife scorns her own relatives As they arrive with rich presents.
prakrit: अहिआइमाणिणो दुग्गअस्स छाइं पइस्स रक्खंही,णिअवंधवाण जूरइ घरिणी विहवेण एंताणं

english: Her husband is at hand And the festival in full swing. Yet she delays putting on her jewels To hearten the woman next door Who is poor And whose husband has still not returned.
prakrit: साहीणे वि पिअअमे पत्ते वि छणे ण मंडिओ अप्पा,दुग्गअपउत्थवइअं सअज्जिअं संठवंतीए

english: To fall in love with a man who returns your love, One who is full of kindness and affection, Makes sense. But to give one's heart to a man who is utterly heartless Is laughable.
prakrit: सब्भावणे हभरिए रत्ते रज्जिज्जइ त्ति जुत्तम् इणं,अणहिअए उण हिअअं जं दिज्जइ तं जणो हसइ

english: If a man shows initiative There is the prospect of either wealth or death. Even if he lacks initiative, death is certain, Wealth is not.
prakrit: आरंभंतस्स धुअं लच्छी मरणं व होइ पुरिसस्स,तं मरणम् अणारंभे वि होइ लच्छी उण ण होइ

english: While making love to another woman His beloved will come to mind Both when he sees and doesn't see A familiar trait.
prakrit: अक्खडइ पिआ हिअए अण्णं महिलाअणं रमंतस्स,दिट्ठे सरिसम्मि गुणे सरिसम्मि गुणे अईसंते

english: Silly girl, Youth races past Like a river in spate, The days are fleeting And the nights unreturning. So why this stubborn sulkiness?
prakrit: णइपूरसच्छहे जोव्वणम्मि अइपवसिएसुदिअहेसु,अणिअत्तासु अ राईसु पुत्ति किं दड्ढमाणेण

english: Every one knows the hardhearted lover Leaves at dawn. Venerable Night, stretch on So that morning will not come.
prakrit: कल्लं किर खरतिअओ पवसिहइ पिओ त्ति सुव्वइ जणम्मि,तह वड्ढ भअवइ णिसे जह से कल्लं चिअ ण होइ

english: As her husband is about to depart She goes from door to door Asking all the women who suffer from absent husbands For the secret of surviving the farewell.
prakrit: होंतपहिअस्स जाआ आउच्छणजीअधारणरहस्सं,पुच्छंती भमइ घरं घरेण पिअविरहसहिरीओ

english: O god, please Let my husband form other attachments, For men who have experience of one person only No longer appreciate what's good and what's bad.
prakrit: अण्णमहिलापसंगं दे देव्व करेसु अम्ह दइअस्स,पुरिसा एक्कंतरसा ण हु दोसगुणे विआणंति

english: Wayfarer, Your shadow is hiding beneath your body, Not showing one bit of itself for fear of the midday sun, So why don't you too take a rest?
prakrit: थोअं पि ण णीइ इमा मज्झण्हे उअ सरीरतललुक्का,आअवभएण छाही वि ता पहिअ किं ण वीसमसी

english: By bringing that man Who keeps his distance To ask me how I'm feeling, You have proved a blessing. Now, fever, if you take my life, I will not complain.
prakrit: सुहउच्छअं जणं दुल्लहं पि दूराहि अम्ह आणेंत,उअआरअ जर जीअं पि णेंत ण कआवराहोसि

english: Why should anyone care Whether my fever has abated or not? You, my dear, asking how I am And smelling so fragrant, Do not touch me who stink of fever.
prakrit: आम जरो मे मंदो अहव ण मंदो जणस्स का तत्ती,सुहउच्छअ सुहअ सुअंधगंध मा गंधिरिं छिवसु

english: Your long hair sways like a peacock's fan, Your thighs quiver, your eyes half close, With long pauses you sort of play the man. Now do you see what hard work it is For a man?
prakrit: सिहिपिच्छलुलिअकेसे वेवंतोरु विणिमीलिअद्धच्छी,दरपुरिसाइनि विसमिरि जाणसु पुरिसाण जं दुक्खं

english: Love Estranged and patched up again, Once its dissolution is plain to see, Will never taste right again Like water that has boiled then cooled
prakrit: पेम्मस्स विरोहिअसंधिअस्स पच्चक्खदिट्ठविलिअस्स,उअअस्स व ताविअसीअलस्स विरसो रसो होइ

english: Thinking she hears the twang of her husband's bow Above the crashing thunder, The captive wife tells the royal hostages To wipe away their tears.
prakrit: वज्जवडनाइरिक्कं पइणो सोऊण सिंजिणीघोसं,पुसिआइ करिमरीए सरिवंदीणं पि अच्छीइं

english: It is only the echo of a thunderclap From an early rain cloud. I suppose you were hoping it might be the twang Of your husband's bow, For why else is the hair on your body bristling?
prakrit: करिमरि अआलगज्जिरजलआसणिवडणपडिरवो एसो,पइणो धणुरव कंखिरि रोमंचं किं मुहा वहसि

english: Because she put up with it all The clumsy youth went on making love to her So that her limbs now look like wilting acacia flowers.
prakrit: सहइ सहइ त्ति तेण तहा रमिआ सुरअदुव्विअड्डेण,पव्वाअसिरीसाइ व जह से जाआइ अंगाइं

english: She does not complain to her husband About his brother's advances Not because she herself has impure thoughts But because he is so touchy And she is afraid of causing a split in the family. Instead she pines away.
prakrit: असरिसचित्ते दिअरे सुद्धमणा पिअअमे विसमसीले,ण कहइ कुडुंवविहडणभएण तणुआअए सोण्हा

english: Imagining how it was when her lover was with her, The woman suddenly remembered how angry she had been And raged against thin air. Far from laughing, her friends wept for her.
prakrit: चिंताणिअदइअसमागमम्मि कअमण्णुआइ भरिऊण,सुण्णं कलहा अंती सहीहि रुण्णा ण ओहसिआ

english: Dealings with sympathetic people, Even if inconclusive, Are, I think, more pleasant Than dealings concluded With their opposite.
prakrit: हिअअण्णुएहि समअं असमत्ताइं पि जह सुहावेंति,कज्जाइ मणे ण तहा इअरेहि समाणिआइं पि

english: Look! A tender shoot has sprouted from the stone of a ripe mango. It looks like an eel hiding in a half-opened oyster shell.
prakrit: दरफुडिअसिप्पिसंपुडणिलुक्कहालाहलग्गछेप्पणिहं,पिक्कंवट्ठिविणिग्गअकोमलम् अंवंकुरं उअह

english: Look at that spider climbing down from the rafters Along a thread spun from between its feet: It looks like a mimosa flower strung on an invisible string.
prakrit: उअह पडलंतरोइण्णणिअअतंतुद्धपाअपडिलग्गं,दुल्लक्खसुत्तगुत्थेक्कवउलकुसुमं व मक्कडअं

english: If you are not his lover, How come you sleep every day, Your limbs as weak As those of a newborn buffalo calf, Drunk on its mother's milk?
prakrit: जइ होसि ण तस्स पिआ अणुदिअहं णीसहेहि अंगेहिं,णवसूअपीअपेओसमत्तपाडि व्व किं सुअसि

english: The winter nights are long, For months your husband's been away, So you must be sleeping well. How odd that you should fall asleep by day.
prakrit: हेमंतिआसु अइदीहरासु राईसु तं सि अविणिद्दा,चिरअरपउत्थवइए ण सुंदरं जं दिआ सुअसि

english: If that woman, who stepped on your foot As she leapt away from the mud, Were so indifferent, Why, my dear, is your body now covered With gooseflesh?
prakrit: जइ चिक्खिल्लभउप्पुअपअम् इणम् अलसाइ तुह पए दिण्णं,ता सुहअ कंडइज्जंतम् अंगम् एण्हिं किणो वहसि

english: Once the festival starts its glamor is over, Like the full moon in broad daylight, Like sex which in the end loses its savor, Or like gratitude without a steady stream of gifts.
prakrit: पत्तो छणो ण सोहइ अइप्पहाए व्व पुण्णिमाअंदो,अंतविरसो व्व कामो असंपआणो अ परिओसो

english: Already at her wedding Paravati's friends knew she would be happy When Siva tossed aside The snake bracelet that frightened her.
prakrit: पाणिग्गहणे च्चिअ पव्वईअ णाअं सहीहि सोहग्गं,पसुवइणा वासुइकंकणम्मि ओसारिए दूरं

english: What you see are the heights of the Vindhya Painted black by the forest fires of summer, Not fresh rain clouds. So do not worry about your husband's return.
prakrit: गिंहे दवग्गिमसिमइलिआइ दीसंति विंझसिहराइं,आससु पउत्थवइए ण होंति णवपाउसब्भाइं

english: Give as much affection As you can muster. For not everyone can bear to suffer The withdrawal of kindness.
prakrit: जेत्तिअमेत्तं तीरइ णिव्वोढुं देसु तेत्तिअं पणअं,ण जणो विणिअत्तपसाअदुक्खसहणक्खमो सव्वो

english: How can a woman Who for five whole days Has been the lover of such an attractive man Ask for one day more? One cannot feast on dainties.
prakrit: वहुवल्लहस्स जा होइ वल्लहा कह वि पंच दिअहाइं,सा किं छट्ठं मग्गइ कत्तो मिट्ठं च वहुअं च

english: Whatever part of my body he stares at I cover. At the same time I want him to see it.
prakrit: जं जं सो णिज्झाअइ अंगोआसं महं अणिमिसच्छो,पच्छाएमि अ तं तं इच्छामि अ तेण दीसंतं

english: See how the woman's indignation at her husband Escapes with a soft sigh Like sand from a clenched fist.
prakrit: दढमण्णुदूमिआइ वि गहिओ दइअम्मि पेछह इमीए,ओसरइ वालुआमुट्ठिओ व्व माणो सुरसुरंतो

english: More than his absence abroad Or my wretchedness here at home What pains me is my husband returning Without quite reaching his goal.
prakrit: ण वि तह विएसवासो दोग्गच्चं मह जणेइ संतावं,आसंसिअत्थविमुहो जह पणइअणो णिअत्तंतो

english: I will never forget how she shook her head When I tried to kiss her lips And her tresses flew in all directions. Her face looked like a lotus Surrounded by a swarm of bees Excited by its fragrance.
prakrit: भरिमो से गहिआहरधुअसीसपहोलिरालआउलिअं,वअणं परिमलतरलिअभमरालिपइण्णकमलं व

english: When her rivals take a freezing cold bath Before dressing for the festival, The youngest wife shows her privileged position By not bothering.
prakrit: हल्लफलण्हाणपसाहिआण छणवासरे सवत्तीण,अज्जाइ मज्जणाणाअरेण कहिअं व सोहग्गं

english: You won't make anyone happy By sitting here Removing with a bamboo needle The traces of turmeric soap From the meshes of your filigree bracelet.
prakrit: ण्हाणहलिद्दाभरिअंतराइ जालाइ जालवलअस्स,सोहंति किलिंचिअकंटएण कं काहिसि कअत्थं

english: Love vanishes Through not seeing enough of one another, Through seeing too much of one another, Through spiteful gossip, And sometimes just like that.
prakrit: अद्दंसणेण पेम्मं अवेइ अइदंसणेण वि अवेइ,पिसुणजणकंपिएण वि अवेइ एमेअ वि अवेइ

english: Thinking how wretched it is To be sagging over her stomach After having once been prominent —That's how her breasts must have got dark nipples.
prakrit: पोट्टपडिएहि दुक्खं अच्छिज्जइ उण्णएहि होऊण,इअ चिंतंताण मणे थणाण कसणं मुहं जाअं

english: Lovely woman, The farmer has become so thin On your account That his good wife, though jealous, Now acts as go-between.
prakrit: सो तुज्झ कए सुंदरि तह झीणो सुमहिलो हलिअउत्तो,जह से मच्छरिणीअ वि दोच्चं जाआइ पडिवण्णं

english: Though you visit us only out of courtesy, You rejoice our heart. What delight you must give to those Whom you visit with genuine fondness.
prakrit: दक्खिण्णेण वि एंतो सुहअ सुहावेसि अंह हिअआइं,णिक्कइअवेण जाणं गओ सि का णिव्वुई ताणं

english: While he was blowing on the hand That still stung from the slap I gave him, I could not help laughing And put my other hand around his neck.
prakrit: एक्कं पहरुग्घाअं हत्थं मुहमारुएण वीअंतो,सो वि हसंतीअ मए गहिओ वीएण कंठम्मि

english: Proud lady, When he approached you You relentlessly turned away, But the gooseflesh on your back Shows that in your heart You are prepared to face him again.
prakrit: अवलंविअमाणपरंमुहीअ एंतस्स माणिनि पिअस्स,पुट्ठिपुलउग्गमो तुह कहेइ समुहट्ठिअं हिअअं

english: She knows how to give expression To what remains of the anger he tried to conciliate By acting with reserve Even when they are alone together.
prakrit: जानइ जाणावेउं अणुणअविद्दविअमाणपरिसेसं,पइरिक्कम्मि वि विणआवलंवणं स च्चिअ कुणंती

english: How dare you! And which offenses am I supposed to forgive, My darling: Those you have committed, Those you are committing, Or those you are about to commit?
prakrit: किं दाव कआ अहवा करेसि काहिसि अ सुहअ एत्ताहे,अवराहाण अलज्जिर साहसु कअरा खमिज्जंति

english: Women only like men Who mask their authority And grovel like slaves At their angry lovers' feet. All the rest make pitiful husbands.
prakrit: णूमंति जे पहुत्तं कुविअं दास व्व जे पसाअंति,ते च्चिअ महिलाण पिआ सेसा सामि च्चिअ वराआ

english: Ungrateful bee, Once you would not think Of enjoying yourself with other flowers But now that the jasmine is heavy with fruit You forsake her.
prakrit: तइआ कअग्घ महुअर ण रमसि अण्णासु पुप्फजाईसु,वद्धफलभारगरुइं मालइम् एण्हिं परिच्चअसि

english: Aunt, A glimpse of that man, Whom one could never tire of staring at, Is like drinking water in a dream: It has not quenched my thirst.
prakrit: अविअण्हपेच्छणिज्जेण तक्खणं मामि तेण दिट्ठेण,सिविणअपीएण व पाणिएण तण्ह च्चिअ ण फिट्टा

english: Though he may for a moment Slip one's mind One still remembers a person. But love, Once it is but a memory, Vanishes For it is something immaterial.
prakrit: सो णाम संभरिज्जइ पब्भसिओ जो खणं पि हिअआहि,संभरिअव्वं च कअं गअं च पेम्मं णिरालंवं

english: The poor girl cherishes the teeth marks You have just left on her cheeks Like a pledge, Protecting them with a fence of gooseflesh.
prakrit: णासं व सा कवोलेअज्ज वितुह दंतमंडलं वाला,उब्भिण्णपुलअवइवेढपरिगअं रक्खइ वराई

english: The mango puts out new shoots, The fragrance of liquor fills the air, An agreeable breeze is blowing from the south, But business must mean more to him And clearly he loves me no longer.
prakrit: दिट्ठा चूआ अग्घाइआ सुरा दक्खिणाणिलो सहिओ,कज्जाइं चिअ गरुआइ मामि को वल्लहो कस्स

english: After making love, He took a step, then turned And took me in his arms again. That moment I felt what it was to be a wife whose husband is abroad And he what it was to be that woman's husband.
prakrit: रमिऊण पअं पि गओ जाहे उवऊहिउं पडिणिउत्तो,अहअं पउत्थवइअ व्व तक्खणं सो पवासि व्व

english: A man so handsome One cannot tire of looking at him, Who shares one's troubles as well as one's joys, Proves faithful and returns one's love —Such a man is only to be got through merit Accumulated over many lives.
prakrit: अविअण्हपेच्छणिज्जं समसुहदुक्खं विइण्णसब्भावं,अण्णोण्णहिअअलग्गं पुण्णेहि जणो जणं लहइ

english: If one loves a man He gives pleasure even while causing pain. Though wounded by a lover's nails Breasts thrill with gooseflesh.
prakrit: दुक्खं देंतो वि सुहं जणेइ जो जस्स वल्लहो होइ,दइअणहदूमिआण वि वड्ढइ थणआण रोमंचो

english: Try though she would to keep it, The advice given by her friends Escaped from her heart That was shattered by the arrow of the God of Love.
prakrit: धरिओ धरिओ विअलइ उवएसो पिअसहीहि दिज्जंतो,मअरद्धअवाणपहारजज्जरे तीअ हिअअम्मि

english: O sweetwood tree, Whose branches, bowed by the weight of blossom, Reach to the ground In the broad thickets on the bank of the Goda, Do me a favor And shed your leaves slowly.
prakrit: वहुपुप्फभरोणामिअभूमीगअसाह सुणसु विण्णत्तिं,गोलाअडविअडकुडंग महुअ सणिअं गलिज्जासु

english: Weeping, The woman gathers the very last sweetwood flowers Now painful to behold, Like the bones of a relative On the funeral pyre.
prakrit: णिप्पच्छिमाइ असई दुक्खालोआइ महुअपुप्फाइं,चीए वंधुस्स व अट्ठिआइ रुअरी समुच्चिणइ

english: Heart, After getting stuck here and there, Like a log Borne along by the current of a shallow stream, One day you will be fuel for someone.
prakrit: ओ हिअअ मडहसरिआजलरअहीरंतदीहदारु व्व,ठाणे ठाणे च्चिअ लग्गमाण केणा ऽवि डज्झिहिसि

english: The red That during the night her husband Removed from her lips Appears the next morning In her co-wives' sleepless eyes.
prakrit: जो तीअ अहरराओ रत्तिं उव्वासिओ पिअअमेण,सो च्चिअ दीसइ गोसे सवत्तिणअणेसु संकंतो

english: When the poor plowman's daughter Saw her courteous husband standing on the river bank She clambered up By the most difficult route.
prakrit: गोलाअडट्ठिअं पेच्छिऊण गहवइसुअं हलिअसोण्हा,आढत्ता उत्तरिउं दुक्खुत्ताराइ पअवीए

english: I will never forget, Once when he lay in silence at my feet, What pleasure I got from twisting his hair round my toe And pulling hard.
prakrit: चलणोआसणिसण्णस्स तस्स भरिमो अणालवंतस्स,पाअंगुट्ठावेढिअकेसदढाअड्ढणसुहेल्लिं

english: See how the winter traveler At the gate of the village temple Jabs at the smoldering heap of husks As if it were a bear.
prakrit: फालेइ अच्छभल्लं व उअह कुग्गामदेउलद्दारे,हेमंतआलपहिओ विज्झाअंतं पलालग्गिं

english: Aunt, Not a lotus is damaged, Not a goose has been scared away, But someone has pushed a cloud on its back In the village pond.
prakrit: कमलाअरा ण मलिआ हंसा उड्डाविआ ण अ पिउच्छा,केण वि गामतडाए अब्भं उत्ताणिअं छूढं

english: How frustrated he must feel To threaten to leave again. It makes his young wife languish As though she'd been given a drug.
prakrit: केण मणे भग्गमणोरहेण संलाविअं पवासो त्ति,सविसाइ व अलसाअंति जेण वहुआइ अंगाइं

english: As his mother Yasoda says: "Krsna a is still a child," The women of Vraja smile to themselves, Their eyes fixed on his face.
prakrit: अज्ज वि वालो दामोअरो त्ति इअ जंपिए जसोआए,कण्हमुहपेसिअच्छं णिहुअं हसिअं वअवहूहिं

english: Placing herself next to Rasha On the pretext of praising the way she dances, The cunning cowgirl manages to kiss Krsna, Who is reflected in his favorite's cheek.
prakrit: णच्चणसलाहणणिहेण पासपरिसंठिआ णिउणगोवी,सरिगोविआण चुंवइ कवोलपडिमागअं कण्हं

english: On the heights of the Vindhya The Pulindas kneel behind their bows The moment they see the valleys below Filling with rain clouds As if with a herd of elephants.
prakrit: आलोअंति पुलिंदा पव्वअसिहरट्ठिआ धणुणिसण्णा,हत्थिउलेहि व विंझं पूरिज्जंतं णवब्भेहिं

english: The Vindhya Range with white clouds Clinging to its body blackened by forest fires Looks like Visnu splashed While churning the Ocean of Milk.
prakrit: वणदवमसिमइलंगो रेहइ विंझो घणेहि धवलेहिं,खीरोअमंथणुच्छलिअदुद्धसित्तो व्व महुमहणो

english: Though distressed by the death of her relatives The hostage made eyes at her kidnapper Who was a handsome youth. For who begrudges anyone His good points?
prakrit: वंदीअ णिहअवंधवविमणाइ वि पक्कलो त्ति चोरजुवा,अणुराएण पुलइओ गुणेसु को मच्छरं वहइ

english: For how many days Has the hunter's young and beautiful wife Proudly scattered her happiness all over the streets In the guise of shavings from her husband's bow?
prakrit: अज्ज कइमो वि दिअहो वाहवहू रूवजोव्वणुम्मत्ता,सोहग्गं धणुरुंपच्छलेण रच्छासु विक्किरइ

english: See how the wood shavings Swirl above the hunter's homestead, Like a banner Announcing the joys of marriage.
prakrit: उक्खिप्पइ मंडलिमारुएण गेहंगणाहि वाहीए,सोहग्गधअवडाअ व्व उवह धणुरुंपरिंछोली

english: Though completely exhausted by making love to his young wife, He did not wish to hurt the feelings of his elder wife. So the hunter took his bow with him into the forest Even though he could not bend it Without first shaving it thinner.
prakrit: णववहुपेम्मतनुइओ पणअं पढमघरिणीअ रक्खंतो,अलिहिअदुप्परिअल्लं पि णेइ रण्णं धणुं वाहो

english: In this world, Mother, Love without deceit does not exist, For who would separate Or who, being separated, Would survive?
prakrit: कइअवरहिअं पेम्मं ण त्थि च्चिअ मामि माणुसे लोए,अह होइ कस्स विरहो विरहे होंतम्मि को जिअइ

english: It was like a miracle, Like finding treasure, Like being king in heaven, Like a draught of nectar, That one moment When I saw her undressed.
prakrit: अच्छेरं व णिहिं मिव सग्गे रज्जं व अमअपाणं व,आसि म्ह तं मुहुत्तं विणिअंसणदंसणं तिस्सा

english: You love her, I love you, She hates you, And you hate me. I speak plainly Since love is full of complications.
prakrit: सा तुज्झ वल्लहा तं सि मज्झ वेसो सि तीअ तुज्झ अहं,वालअ फुडं भणामो पेम्मं किर वहुविआरं ति

english: I am shy And he is ready for anything, But my friends will help me out, So why should I paint my feet?
prakrit: अहअं लज्जालुइणी तस्स अ उम्मच्छराइ पेम्माइं,सहिआअणो वि णिउणो अलाहि किं पाअराएण

english: The spring wind stirs the forest, Loud with the drone of bees, And the cowgirl's song About parted lovers Troubles the lonely traveler.
prakrit: महुमासमारुआहअमहुअरझंकारणिब्भरे रण्णे,गाइ विरहख्हरावद्धपहिअमणमोहणं गोवी

english: The sun is already shining When the good wife Takes hold of her husband's feet And gives them a shake. Since she is smiling A smile appears on his grumpy face.
prakrit: सालोअ च्चिअ सूरे घरिणी घरसामिअस्स घेत्तूण,णेच्छंतस्स वि पाए धुअइ हसंती हसंतस्स

english: His image is in my eyes, His touch on my limbs, His words in my ear And his heart in my heart. To separate us needs more than just fate.
prakrit: रूअं अच्छीसु ठिअं फरिसो अंगेसु जंपिअं कण्णे,हिअअं हिअए णिहिअं विओइअं किं थ देव्वेण

english: Eyes shut, She imagines her husband on the bed And embraces herself While the bracelets fall loose Upon her thin arms.
prakrit: सअणे चिंतामइअं काऊण पिअं णिमीलिअच्छीए,अप्पाणो उवऊढो पसिढिलवलआहि वाहाहिं

english: This wretched body is the ruin of me: In daily humiliation It totters from door to door On other people's business Yet refuses to die.
prakrit: परिभूएण वि दिअहं घरघरभमिरेण अण्णकज्जम्मि,चिरजीविएण इमिणा खविअ म्हो डड्ढकाएण

english: However abundant, A miser's wealth is useless, Like the traveler's shadow When he is scorched by the summer heat.
prakrit: होंती वि णिप्फल च्चिअ धणरिद्धी होइ किविणपुरिसस्स,गिम्हाअवसंतत्तस्स णिअअछाहि व्व पहिअस्स

english: O my left eye, If my husband comes home today Thanks to your quivering, I will reward you with a good long look at him While keeping my right eye tightly shut.
prakrit: फुरिए वामच्छि तए जइ एहिइ सो पिओ ज्ज ता सुइरं,सम्मीलिअ दाहिणअं तुइ अविअण्हं पुलोइस्सं

english: That the bee wants to drink the nectar Of one flower after another Is the fault of the flowers running out of nectar, Not the bee's.
prakrit: अण्णण्णं कुसुमरसं जं किर सो महइ महुअरो पाउं,तं णीरसाण दोसो कुसुमाणं णेअ भमरस्स

english: Leaning on the door Looking out for you She decorates the house for your return: Her breasts two vases of plenty And her eyes lotus petals strewn on the street.
prakrit: रच्छापइण्णणअणुप्पला तुमं सा पडिच्छए एंतं,दारणिहिएहि दोहि वि मंगलकलसेहि व थणेहिं

english: She wept as long as she had tears to weep, She grew as thin as her body would allow, And, poor thing, Sighed as long as she had breath to sigh.
prakrit: ता रुण्णं जा रुव्वइ ता झीणं जाव झिज्जए अंगं,ता णीससिअ वराईअ जाव सासा पहुप्पंति

english: Of a couple, Who after a long life of shared joys and sorrows Have learned the meaning of love, The one who dies survives, The other is as good as dead.
prakrit: समसोक्खदुक्खपरिवड्ढिआण कालेण रूढपेम्माण,मिहुणाण मरइ जं तं खु जिअइ इअरं मुअं होइ

english: Foolish girl, do not cry. A fresh mango shoot with its new blossom Placed on the mouth of the farewell bowl Will surely stop your lover departing.
prakrit: हरिहिइ पिअस्स णवचूअपल्लवो पढममंजरिसणाहो,मा रुअसु पुत्ति पत्थाणकलसमुहसंठिओ गमणं

english: That jealous anger which my friends, Having found a slit, Managed to lodge in my heart, Sneaked away like a lover At the sight of my husband.
prakrit: जो कह वि मह सहीहिं छिद्दं लहिऊण पेसिओ हिअए,सो माणो चोरिअकामुओ व्व दिट्ठे पिए णट्ठो

english: Her friends told the young wife That a safflower was clinging to her breast, And burst into laughter When she tried to brush off the nail marks.
prakrit: सहिआहि भण्णमाणा थणए लग्गं कुसुंभउप्फं ति,मुद्धवहुआ हसिज्जइ पप्फोडंती णहवआइं

english: These indifferent side glances of yours, Which turn this way and that But take no notice of me, Cut me to the quick.
prakrit: उम्मूलेंति व हिअअं इमाइ रे तुह विरज्जमाणस्स,अवहीरणवसविस्ãठुलवलंतणअणद्धदिट्ठाइं

english: The drowsy glances of a moon-faced woman, Her half-veiled pupils darting to and fro, Are irresistible Even to the God of Love.
prakrit: णिद्दालसपरिघुम्मिरतंसवलंतद्धतारआलोआ,कामस्स वि दुव्विसहा दिट्ठिणिवाआ ससिमुहीए

english: The young wife inspecting her heavy and prominent breasts For fresh nail marks Adorned them with the lotuses of her eyes Which were mirrored in their smooth expanse.
prakrit: अज्जाइ णवणहक्खअणिरिक्खणे गरुअजोव्वणुत्तुंगं,पडिमागअणिअणअणुप्पलच्चिअं होइ थणवट्ठं

english: Don't make your rivals happy: When your lover is eager to please you, Humor him, For, dear girl, By doling out oversize portions of disdain You will dwindle to nothing.
prakrit: मा कुण पडिवक्खसुहं अणुणेसु पिअं पसाअलोहिल्लं,अइगहिअगरुअमाणेण पुत्ति रासि व्व झिज्जिहिसि

english: The tear mixed with eye-black Looks like a line drawn around her heart To guide the saw of separation In its agonizing surgery
prakrit: विरहकरवत्तदूसह फालिज्जंतम्मि तीअ हिअअम्मि,अंसू कज्जलमइलं पमाणसुत्तं व पडिहाइ

english: My boy, Don't be so hasty. This isn't the place To leave things for safekeeping. As far as I know, Hearts deposited here Are not returned.
prakrit: दुण्णिक्खेवअम् एअं पुत्तअ मा साहसं करिज्जासु,एत्थ णिहित्ताइ मणे हिअआइ पुणो ण लब्भंति

english: The wife who had already reached her climax But did not realize that that was the end of that Remained in a state of excitement Expecting something more.
prakrit: णिव्वुत्तरआ वि वहू सुरअविरामट्ठिइं अआणंती,अविरअहिअआ अण्णं पि किं पि अत्थि त्ति चिंतेइ

english: Praise be to the fond attentions of prostitutes Who minister to everyone's need for the pleasures of love With a whole armory of wiles.
prakrit: णंदंतु सुरअसुहरसतण्हावहराइ सअललोअस्स,वहुकइअवमग्गविणिम्मिआइ वेसाण पेम्माइं

english: I suppose you have never felt The pain of grief, That you ask me, laughingly, Why I am so thin. When you have found a fickle lover yourself, I will explain.
prakrit: अप्पत्तमण्णुदुक्खो किं मं किसिअ त्ति पुच्छसि हसंतो,पावसि जा चलचित्तं पिअं जणं ता तुह कहिस्सं

english: Are these the pleasures For which I threw myself upon you, Brushing aside the warnings of my friends, And for lack of which my life Now hangs in the balance?
prakrit: अवहत्थिऊण सहिजंपिआइ जाणं कएण रमिओ सि,एआइ ताइ सोक्खाइ संसओ जेहि जीअस्स

english: He is so jealous That he does not want his wife To gather sweetwood flowers at night. Instead, the honest soul Goes and gathers them himself.
prakrit: ईसालुओ पई से रत्तिं महुअं ण देइ उच्चेउं,उच्चेइ अप्पण च्चिअ माए अइउज्जुअसहाओ

english: Why storm off Trailing your skirt behind you? Slow down! Aren't you afraid your waist might break Under the weight of your breasts?
prakrit: अच्छोडिअवत्थद्धंतपत्थिए मंथरं तुमं वच्च,चिंतेसि थणहराआसिअस्स मज्झस्स वि ण भंगं

english: For some time the traveler has been sipping water From his cupped hand, Keeping his fingers wide apart, All the while looking up towards the woman at the well, Who in turn has reduced the already thin stream To a mere trickle.
prakrit: उद्धच्छो पिअइ जलं जह जह विरलंगुली चिरं पहिओ,पावालिआ वि तह तह धारं तणुअं पि तणुएइ

english: While the begging monk looks down at her navel, And the housewife looks at the moon of his face, The crows plunder the dish in her hands And the begging bowl in his.
prakrit: भिच्छअरो पेच्छइ णाहिमंडलं सा वि तस्स मुहअंदं,तं चट्टुअं करंकं दोण्ह वि काआ विलुंपंति

english: If you cannot live without the man, You'd better stay on good terms with him Whatever wrong he may have done. Even after the town has gone up in flames One cannot do without fire.
prakrit: जेण विणा ण जिविज्जइ अणुणिज्जइ सो कआवराहो वि,पत्ते वि णअरडाहे भण कस्स ण वल्लहो अग्गी

english: To whom can I give a sly glance, With whom can I share my joys and sorrows, With whom can I joke, In this dump of a village Full of yokels?
prakrit: वंकं को पुलइज्जउ कस्स कहिज्जउ सुहं व दुक्खं व,केण समं व हसिज्जउ पामरपउरे हअग्गामे

english: As the faithless wife puts the auspicious mark on the plowshare On the first day of plowing the cotton field She is already so full of desire that her hands tremble
prakrit: फलहीवाहणपुण्णाहमंगलं लंगले कुणंतीए,असईअ मणोरहगब्भिणीअ हत्था थरहरंति

english: Afraid that travelers Might cut the hanging roots of the shady banyan To let light in, The faithless women stealthily spattered the leaves With white.
prakrit: पहिउल्लूरणसंकाउलाहि असईहि वहलतिमिरस्स,आइप्पणेण णिहुअं वडस्स सित्ताइ पत्ताइं

english: Of course the sight of her precious face Is enough to rob any man of his senses. But to glimpse the outskirts of her village Is a joy in itself.
prakrit: अच्छउ दाव मणहरं पिआइ मुहदंसणं अइमहग्घं,तग्गामछेत्तसीमा वि झत्ति दिट्ठा सुहावेइ

english: Though he had no more work in the fields, The farmer would not go home, To spare himself the pain Of finding it empty Now his wife was dead.
prakrit: णिक्कम्माहि वि छेत्ताहि पामरो णेअ वच्चए वसहिं,मुअपिअजाआसुण्णइअगेहदुक्खं परिहरंतो

english: After the storm had ripped the straw from the roof And rainwater streamed through the rafters, The good lady tried to cover the wall with her hands To protect the tally she'd made of her husband's absence.
prakrit: झंझावाउत्तिणघरविवरपलोट्टंतसलिलधाराहिं,कुड्डलिहिओहिदिअहं रक्खइ अज्जा करअलेहिं

english: With a tame peacock's tail feather behind her ear The hunter's young wife saunters among his elder wives Who are themselves decked out with pearls Which their husband once cut loose From the temples of fierce elephants.
prakrit: सिहिपेहुणावअंसा वहुआ वाहस्स गव्विरी भमइ,गअमोत्तिअरइअपसाहणाण मज्झे सवत्तीण

english: My son, Only someone who has acquired merit In past lives Can win the love Of women With their sly look, sly talk, Sly smile and sly walk.
prakrit: वंकच्छिपेच्छिरीणं वंकुल्लविरीण वंकभमिरीणं,वंकहसिरीण पुत्तअ पुण्णेहि जणो पिओ होइ

english: Your holiness, It's safe for you to walk in the village now. The dog that bothered you Has been killed by a fierce lion Who lives in the thickets of the Goda.
prakrit: भम धम्मिअ वीसद्धो सो सुणहो अज्ज मारिओ तेण,गोलाअडविअडकुडुंगवासिणा दरिअसीहेण

english: When the wind has blown pollen From the lotus on my ear Into my eye Only a god can steal a kiss While blowing it out.
prakrit: वाएरिएण भरिअं अच्छिं कण्णरइउप्पलरएण,फुक्कंतो अविअण्हं चुंवंतो को सि देव्वाणं

english: Friend, The orange kadamba flowers give me more pain Than all other flowers put together. It's as if these days The God of Love has a bow that shoots sweets
prakrit: सहि दुम्मेंति कलंवाइं जह मं तह ण सेसकुसुमाइं,णूणं इमेसु दिअहेसु वहइ गुलिआधणुं कामो

english: I am not her go-between, You are not her lover, So what have we to do with each other? But let me tell you the truth: She is dying, And the disgrace is yours.
prakrit: णा ऽहं दूई ण तुमं पिओ त्ति को अम्ह एत्थ वावारो,सा मरइ तुज्झ अअसो एअं धम्मक्खरं भणिमो

english: From her face to your face And from your face to my feet, Going from one to the other, The dot painted on her forehead Has performed a real miracle.
prakrit: तीअ मुहाहि तुह मुहं तुज्झ मुहाओ अ मज्झ चलणम्मि,हत्थाहत्थीअ गओ अइदुक्करकारओ तिलओ

english: How the young beauty's face grows dark When, with a furtive glance, she sees The plowman flaunting an ear ornament Of rose-apple leaves.
prakrit: सामाइ सामलिज्जइ अद्धच्छिपलोइरीअ मुहसोहा,जंवूदलकअकण्णावअंसभमिरे हलिअउत्ते

english: Go-between! You're brilliant —The way you know how to mix rough with smooth. Please, do it in such a way That he itches all over Without having a rash.
prakrit: दूइ तुमं चिअ कुसला कक्खडमउआइ जाणसे वोत्तुं,कंडूइपंडरं जह ण होइ तह तं करेज्जासु

english: Finding no room Among the thousands of women That crowd your heart, She does nothing else each day But make her thin body even thinner.
prakrit: महिलासहस्सभरिए तुह हिअए सुहअ सा अमाअंती,दिअहं अणण्णकम्मा अंगं तणुअं पि तणुएइ

english: Impossible, even for a moment, To banish her dark presence from my heart. Every day the same pain, undiminished, Like being haunted by a secret sin.
prakrit: खणमेत्तं पि ण फिट्टइ अणुदिअह विइण्णगरुअसंतावा,पच्छण्णपावसंक व्व सामली मज्झ हिअआओ

english: You fool, What makes you think I'm angry? Stop your needless groveling And take me in your arms. What's the point in my sulking? It only makes you angry.
prakrit: अण्णुअ णा ऽहं कुविआ उवऊहसु किं मुहा पसाएसि,तुह मण्णुसमुप्पाएण मज्झ माणेण वि ण कज्जं

english: Drenched by tears, Scorched by long, hot sighs, Her lips in your absence Perform the penance of fire and water.
prakrit: दीहुण्हपउरणीसासपअविओ वाहसलिलपरिसित्तो,साहेइ सामसवलं व तीअ अहरो तुह विओए

english: A lake in autumn Is warm only on the surface. Below it stays cool, Like a good man when displeased.
prakrit: सरए महद्दहाणं अंतोसिसिराइ वाहिरुण्हाइं,जाआइ कुविअसज्जणहिअअसरिच्छाइ सलिलाइं

english: When he comes what shall I do? What shall I say? And how will it be? The girl's heart trembles At her first chance to be reckless.
prakrit: आअस्स किं णु काहं किं वोच्छं कह णु होहिइ इमं ति,पढमुग्गअसाहसआरिआइ हिअअं थरहरेइ

english: By disentangling her husband's hair From the clasp of her anklet As he lies at her feet, She tells him That pride has left her heart.
prakrit: णेउरकोडिविलग्गं चिउरं दइअस्स पाअपडिअस्स,हिअअं पउत्थमाणं उम्मोअंति च्चिअ कहेइ

english: Haven't you heard how that lovely girl ruined her soft skin By bathing in the Goda Just where you had smeared yourself With stinging rose-apple lotion?
prakrit: तुज्झ ऽंगराअसेसेण सामली तह खरेण सोमारा,सा किर गोलातूहे ण्हाआ जंवूकसाएण

english: Today he is gone, Today the alleys are empty, The temples are empty, The crossroads are empty, And so is my heart.
prakrit: अज्जं चेअ पउत्थो अज्जं चिअ सुण्णआइ जाआइं,रच्छामुहदेउलचच्चराइ अम्हं च हिअआइं

english: I will never forget how my beloved ran off In anger, With red cheeks, Stammering with trembling lips That I should leave her alone.
prakrit: आअंवंतकवोलं खलिअक्खरजंपिरिं फुरंतोट्ठिं,मा छिवसु त्ति सरोसं समोसरंतिं पिअं भरिमो

english: On the pretext that the steps Down to the Godawere uneven, She clung to his breast While he, purely out of concern, Held her in a tight embrace.
prakrit: गोलाविसमोआरच्छलेण अप्पा उरम्मि से मुक्को,अणुअंपाणिद्दोसं तेण वि सा गाढम् उवऊःआ

english: Though its fragrance is gone, She is still wearing the garland of jasmine you gave her, Like a household god In a deserted town.
prakrit: सा तइ सहत्थदिण्णं अज्ज वि रे सुहअ गंधरहिअं पि,उव्वसिअणअरघरदेवअ व्व ओमालिअं वहइ

english: When he misbehaves I cannot get angry with him, Not even in jest, Not with this body That seems to be on loan And not mine to command.
prakrit: केलीअ वि रूसेउं ण तीरए तम्मि चुक्कविणअम्मि,जाइअएहि वि माए इमेहि अवसेहि अंगेहिं

english: Let her play bunny hops. Don't stop her. She needs the training So that later When she sits on top of her husband She does not collapse Under the weight of her own thighs.
prakrit: उप्फुल्लिआइ खेलउ मा णं वारेहि होउ परिखामा,मा जहणभारगरुई पुरिसाअंती किलिम्मिहइ

english: A village full of young men, Spring, youth, an aged husband, Strong wine, nobody to tell you what to do: The only way to avoid going astray Is to die.
prakrit: पउरजुआणो गामो महुमासो जोव्वणं पई ठेरो,जुण्णसुरा साहीणा असई मा होउ किं मरउ

english: Over and over again I told her the words you confided to me, But claiming she hadn't quite caught them She made me repeat the message a hundred times.
prakrit: वहुसो वि कहिज्जंतं तुह वअणं मज्झ हत्थसंदिट्ठं,ण सुअं ति जंपमाणा पुणरुत्तसअं कुणइ अज्जा

english: The way she looks at you, With love and affection written all over her face, She looks at everyone else as well, To conceal her feelings.
prakrit: पाअडिअणेहसब्भावणिब्भरं तीअ जह तुमं दिट्ठो,संवरणवावडाए अण्णो वि जणो तह च्चेअ

english: "Take it and have a look!" With a broad smile on her face She hands her husband the jujube fruit With the marks on it Of their son's first pair of teeth.
prakrit: गेण्हह पुलोअह इमं पहसिअवअणा पइस्स अप्पेइ,जाआ सुअपढमुब्भिण्णदंतजुअलंकिअं वोरं

english: Never mind the gossip: Judge by your own feelings. Anyway, You have grown so cool That you are beyond reproach.
prakrit: अच्छउ ता जणवाओ हिअअं चिअ अत्तणो तुह पमाणं,तह तं सि मंदणेहो जह ण उवालंभजोग्गो सि

english: You rush ahead, following your own fancy, Always in quest of the unattainable man. One day, heart, as you roam the skies, You'll crash.
prakrit: अप्पच्छंदपहाविर दुल्लहलंभं जणं विमग्गंत,आआसवहेहि भमंत हिअअ कइआ वि भज्जिहिसि

english: Maybe my talents are slight, Maybe for him talents mean nothing, Maybe I have no talents And he knows someone who has.
prakrit: अहव गुण च्चिअ लहुआ अहवा गुणअण्णुओ ण सो लोओ,अहव म्हि णिग्गुणा वा वहुगुणवंतो जणो तस्स

english: The crow refuses the rice ball offered by the woman Whose husband is abroad. Seeing it stuck between the bracelet, Which has slipped from her arm, And the downturned palm of her hand, The bird is wary of a trap.
prakrit: पासासंकी काओ णे ऽच्छइ दिण्णं पि पहिअघरिणीए,ओणत्तकरअलोअलिअवलअमज्झट्ठिअं पिंडं

english: Her friends, Unsure when the final day would come, Stealthily wiped out one or two strokes Of her tally.
prakrit: ओहिदिअहागमासंकिरीहि सहिआहि कुड्डलिहिआओ,दो तिण्णि तहिं मिअ चोरिआइ रेहा पुसिज्जंति

english: "Today he has left." "Today he has left." "Today he has left." Already on the very first morning She covered the whole wall with lines.
prakrit: अज्जं गओ त्ति अज्जं गओ त्ति अज्जं गओ त्ति गणिरीए,पढम च्चिअ दिअहद्धे कुड्डो रेहाहि चित्तलिओ

english: The satisfaction of that first night Was nothing compared to seeing the embarrassment Next day On the lotus of her face.
prakrit: ण वि तह पढमसमागमसुरअसुहे पाविए वि परिओसो,जह वीअदिअहसविलक्खलक्खिए वअणकमलम्मि

english: As he walks towards me, passes, And then looks back, My lover's tremulous glances Are to me like Love's arrows Whatever they may be to others.
prakrit: जे समुहागअवोलंतवलिअपिअपेसिअच्छिविच्छोहा,अह मण्णे मअणसरा जणस्स जे होंति ते होंतु

english: The pleasure of riding your thighs Is for special people only. Take the golden girdle: It had to go through the ordeal of fire and water first.
prakrit: इअरो जणो ण पावइ तुह जहणारुहणसंगमसुहेल्लिं,अणुहवइ कणअदोरो हुअवहवरुणाण माहप्पं

english: Normally one gives away things Of which one has a surplus. But to your husband's other wives you give Something that is not yours to give: Unhappiness.
prakrit: जो जस्स विहवसारो तं सो देइ त्ति किं थ अच्छेरं,अणहोंतं पि हु दिण्णं दोहग्गं तइ सवत्तीणं

english: Her face is round like the moon, Her lips taste like nectar, Grabbing her by the hair And giving her a passionate kiss, What is that like?
prakrit: चंदसरिसं मुहं से सरसो अमअस्स मुहरसो तिस्सा,सकअग्गहरहसुज्जलचुंवणअं कस्स सरिसं से

english: When an opportunity finally offers itself, Endlessly weighing the pros and cons And considering the matter carefully, As if one had all the time in the world, Are sure ways to bungle one's chances.
prakrit: उप्पण्णत्थे कज्जे अइचिंतंतो गुणागुणे तम्मि,चिरआलमंदपेच्छित्तणेण पुरिसो हणइ कज्जं

english: Believe me, I would not believe you If these tears that I weep Were not pierced by the gooseflesh Rising on your back As you kneel before me.

english: Make a friend of the man Who, wherever or whenever it may be, Stands by you in adversity Steady as an image in a wall painting.

prakrit: खिण्णस्स उरे पइणो ठवेइ गिम्हावरण्हरमिअस्स,ओल्लं गलंतकुसुमं ण्हाणसुअंधं चिहुरभारं

english: Reflected in the deer-eyed woman's cheek Covered with fresh tooth marks, The moon looks like a white conch shell Red on the inside.
prakrit: अह सरसदंतमंडलकवोलपडिमागओ मअच्छीए,अंतोसिंदूरिअसंखवत्तकरणिं वहइ चंदो

english: The lover wipes away the silver moonbeams Blending with the blue gleams of her sapphire earrings From the face of his offended mistress, Mistaking them for tears mixed with eye-black.
prakrit: पुसिआ कण्णाहरणेंदणीलकिरणाहआ ससिमऊहा,माणिणिवअणम्मि सकज्जलंसुसंकाइ दइएण

english: In the whole wide world Teeming with thousands of beautiful women The only thing that matches this woman's right side . . . Is her left side.
prakrit: एद्दहमेत्तम्मि जए सुंदरमहिलासहस्सभरिए वि,अणुहरइ णवर तिस्सा वामद्धं दाहिणद्धस्स

english: Since love is fickle I dance to my lover's tune. A creeper twines itself Around the unbending tree
prakrit: जह जह वाएइ पिओ तह तह णच्चामि चंचले पेम्मे,वल्ली वलेइ अंगं सहावथद्धे वि रुक्खम्मि

english: He can be captured only with the greatest difficulty And once captured he is difficult to keep, And even if captured, He is not captured Unless his heart is captured as well
prakrit: दुक्खेहि लब्भइ पिओ लद्धो दुक्खेहि होइ साहीणो,लद्धो वि अलद्धो च्चिअ जइ जह हिअअं तह ण होइ

english: How stupid! She was so anxious to taste the pleasure of being groveled to That she made out that he had done something When he hadn't, And led her innocent lover into devious ways.
prakrit: अव्वो अणुणअसुहकंखिरीअ अकअं कअं कुणंतीए,सरलसहावो वि पिओ अविणअमग्गं वला णीओ

english: Having passed the time By counting the days First on her fingers, then on her toes, The young girl burst into tears, Not knowing what to count with next
prakrit: हत्थेसु अ पाएसु अ अंगुलिगणणाइ अइगआ दिअहा,एण्हिं उण केण गणिज्जउ त्ति भणिउं रुअइ मुद्धा

english: The flowers of the flame trees, Which resemble parrots' beaks, Make the ground resplendent, Like a congregation of monks Prostrate in worship at the feet Of the Buddha
prakrit: कीरमुहसच्छहेहिं रेहइ वसुहा पलासकुसुमेहिं,वुद्धस्स चलणवंदणपडिएहि व भिक्खुसंघेहिं

english: People are not captivated by true qualities But by what takes their fancy. The Pulindas brush pearls aside But seize upon the guñja seeds The jeweler uses as weights.
prakrit: ण गुणेण हीरइ जणो हीरइ जो जेण भाविओ तेण,मोत्तूण पुलिंदा मोत्तिआइ गुंजाउ गेण्हंति

english: Slender girl, Don't be so naïve: Brush off your back All trace of the leaves From the aṃkolla in the yard, Otherwise your clever sisters-in-law will start thinking.
prakrit: पुट्ठिं पुससु किसोअरि पलोहरंकोल्लपत्तचित्तलिअं,छेआहि दिअरजाआहि उज्जुए मा कलिज्जिहिसि

english: The moment I see him I will cover my eyes with both hands, But how am I going to hide my body Which is bristling like a spiky kadamba blossom?
prakrit: अच्छीइ ता थइस्सं दोहि वि हत्थेहि तम्मि दिट्ठम्मि,अंगं कलंवकुसुमं व पुलइअं कह णु ढक्किस्सं

english: The storm snatched the thatch from the roof And the lightning flashed through the rafters As if to show the clouds the helpless wife, Sitting in tears Alone without her husband.
prakrit: झंझावाउत्तिणिए घरम्मि रोऊण णीसहणिसण्णं,दावेइ व गअवइअं विज्जुज्जोओ जलहराणं

english: After she who peeped in to ask how he was Had with her fragrant breath Cooled the bitter medicine, The plowman drained it to the very last drop
prakrit: सुहपुच्छिआइ हलिओ मुहपंकअसुरहिपवणणिव्वविअं,तह पिअइ पअइकडुअं पि ओसहं जह ण णिट्ठाइ

english: Having missed the assignation In all those reed beds, She looks for you everywhere As though in search of lost treasure
prakrit: अह सा तहिं तहिं व्विअ वाणीरवणम्मि चुवकसंकेआ,तुह दंसणं विमग्गइ पब्भट्टणिहाणठाणं च

english: In spring The clusters of jasmine Bar the gate of the courtyard. Even the comfort of looking down the road Is denied to the grass widows.
prakrit: लुम्बीओ अंगणमाहवीण दारग्गलाउ जाआउ,आसासो पंथपलोअणे वि पिट्ठो गअवईणं

english: If her eyes were not closed In ecstasy At seeing her lover, Who would notice the blue lily Behind her ear?
prakrit: पिअदंसणसुहरसमउलिआइ जइ से ण होंति णअणाइं,ता केण कण्णरइअं लक्खिज्जइ कुवलअं तिस्सा

english: When he fell asleep, Exhausted after a day of dragging the plow through thick mud, His wife, Angry at missing the pleasures of love, Cursed the rainy season.
prakrit: चिक्खिल्लखुत्तहलमुहकड्ढणसिढिले पइम्मि पासुत्ते,अप्पत्तमोहणसुहा घणसमअं पामरी सवइ

english: They cause grief, Give pleasure, Create a longing And allay it: Praised be the arrows of the God of Love, Kindred of pleasure and pain.
prakrit: दुम्मेंति देंति सोक्खं कुणंति अणुराअअं रमावेंति,अरइरइवंधवाणं णमो णमो मअणवाणाणं

english: How very puzzling! Though made of flowers They are extremely sharp. Though they make no contact They are irresistibly powerful. Though they cut through the flesh They cause delight —The arrows of the God of Love
prakrit: कुसुममआ वि अइखरा अलद्धफंसा वि दूसहपआवा,भिंदंता वि रइअरा कामस्स सरा वहुविअप्पा

english: They cause jealousy, Kindle love, Make grief bearable And prevent separation from being fatal: Love's arrows have so many different effects.
prakrit: ईसं जणेंति दावेंति मम्महं विप्पिअं सहावेंति,विरहे ण देंति मरिउं अहो गुणा तस्स वहुमग्गा

english: Have a care— The poor girl, wearing a freshly dyed dress, Is distributing festival cakes from door to door In the hope of catching a glimpse of you.
prakrit: णीआइ अज्ज णिक्किव पिणद्धणवरंगआइ वरईए,घरपरिवाडीअ पहेणआइ तुह दंसणासाए

english: Bees pursue the mango blossom That the scruffy farmhand has torn off with his nails And placed on his head, Like young men thronging around a woman Taken hostage
prakrit: णक्खुक्खुडिअं सहआरमंजरिं पामरस्स सीसम्मि,वंदिं मिव हीरंतिं भमरजुआणा अणुसरंति

english: The lamp blown out, Stifled sighs, Fearful whispers, Lips sealed by hundreds of vows: Oh! the joys of stolen love.
prakrit: मुहविज्झविअपईवं णिरुद्धसासं ससंकिउल्लावं,सवहसअरक्खिओट्ठं चोरिअरमिअं सुहावेइ

english: It is pitch-dark outside, My husband left today, And the house is deserted. Please, neighbor, do keep watch: I don't want to be burgled.
prakrit: वहलतमाहअराई अज्ज पउत्थो पई घरं सुण्णं,तह जग्गेसु सअज्जिअ ण जहा अम्हे मुसिज्जामो

english: Without leaving her bedside for a moment The mother nurses her daughter-in-law Who has almost expired at the sight of the first rain clouds, As if she were a medicine which could restore The life of her son
prakrit: संजीवणोसहं मिव सुअस्स रक्खइ अणण्णवावारा,सासू णवब्भदंसणकंठागअजीविअं सोण्हं

english: You live in my heart With your wife locked in your own For tell me how else could she know exactly what I want?
prakrit: णूणं हिअअणिहित्ताइ वससि जाआइ अम्ह हिअअम्मि,अण्णह मणोरहा मे साहसु कह तीअ विण्णाआ

english: When she could no longer follow you With her eyes stretching almost to her ears She poured a libation with rolling tears To the past pleasure of seeing you
prakrit: तइ सुहअ अईसंते तिस्सा अच्छीहि कण्णलग्गेहिं,दिण्णं घोलिरवाहेहि पाणिअं दंसणसुहाणं

english: How much longer can I go on In this misery, My will to live dependent On visualizing your face In my imagination?
prakrit: उप्पेक्खागअ तुह मुहदंसणपडिरुद्धजीविआसाइ,दुहिआइ मए कालो केत्तिअमेत्तो व्व णेअव्वो

english: Don't worry, dear girl, When youth and beauty are all but gone You can still cause pain, Like the sight of one's birthplace From which the familiar faces Have vanished
prakrit: वोलीणालक्खिअरूअजोव्वणा पुत्ति कं ण दूमेसि,दिट्ठा पणट्ठपोराणजणवआ जम्मभूमि व्व

english: In the midst of the crowd A boy speaks through his eyes Shining with delight, And a girl replies As her limbs break out in a sweat
prakrit: परिओसविअसिएहिं भणिअं अच्छीहि तेण जणमज्झे,पडिवण्णं तीअ वि उव्वमंतसेएहि अंगेहिं

english: If he is not dear to you How comes it, my friend, That at the mere mention of his name Your face opens like a lotus Touched by the rays of the sun?
prakrit: जइ सो ण वल्लहो च्चिअ गोत्तग्गहणेण तस्स सहि कीस,होइ मुहं ते रविअरफंसविसट्टं व तामरसं

english: O auntie! Hurrah for the embrace That, like a violent wind, bends the tree of pride, Gives pleasure to the whole body, And is the prologue to the play of love
prakrit: माणदुमपरुसपवणस्स मामि सव्वंगणिव्वुइअरस्स,अवऊहणस्स भद्दं रइणाडअपुव्वरंगस्स

english: Heart, Please, enough of this! How can you slight us and attach yourself To someone whose real worth is unknown, Judging merely by your own feelings?
prakrit: णिअआणुमाणणीसंक हिअअ दे पसिअ विरम एत्ताहे,अमुणिअपरमत्थजणाणुलग्ग कीस म्ह लहुएसि

english: First you made her waste away, Then taught her how to weep and wail, Then made her flout all decency. So, please, do not neglect her now
prakrit: अंगाणं तणुआरअ सिक्खावअ दीहरोइअव्वाणं,विणआइक्कमआरअ मा मा णं पम्हसिज्जासु

english: She knew no way To stop the insistent, ever-increasing Pain of being parted from her lover Except by diverting herself With death
prakrit: अण्णह ण तीरइ च्चिअ परिवड्ढंतगरुअं पिअअमस्स,मरणविणोएण विणा विरमावेउं विरहदुक्खं

english: My boy, I've so often described how nice you are To those sly hussies That it's my fault you're now beyond my reach. Whom else can I blame?
prakrit: वण्णंतीहि तुह गुणे वहुसो अम्हेहि छिंछईपुरओ,वालअ सअम् एअ कओ सि दुल्लहो कस्स कुप्पामो

english: He was embarrassed But I laughed and gave him a hug When he groped for the knot Of my skirt and found it Already undone.
prakrit: जाओ सो वि विलक्खो मए वि हसिऊण गाढम् उवऊढो,पढमोसरिअस्स णिअंसणस्स गंठिं विमग्गंतो

english: Believe me, my dear, The wrongs you have done me Are nothing like as hurtful As these polite words devoid of true feeling
prakrit: अवराहेहि वि ण तहा पत्तिअ जह मं इमेहि दुम्मेसि,अवहत्थिअसब्भावेहि सुहअ दक्खिण्णभणिएहिं

english: Proud lady, silently weeping, Do not scold your arms For straying into the empty hollow That was your lover's embrace.
prakrit: मा जूर पिआलिंगणसरहसभमिरीण वाहुलइआणं,तुण्हिक्क परुण्णेनं इमिणा माणंसिणि मुहेणं

english: My boy, Why go picking flowers? The gods are perfectly happy with offerings of water And the banks of the Godavarê Are the ruin of many a young man.
prakrit: मा वच्च पुप्फलाविर देवा उअअंजलीहि तूसंति,गोलाणईअ पुत्तअ सीलुम्मूलाइ कूलाइं

english: As he sows, The seeds stick to the farmer's hands Which grow moist When he thinks that soon he might be making love With his girl in this very field.
prakrit: एत्थ मए रमिअव्वं तीअ समं चिंतिऊण हिअएण,पामरकरसेउल्ला णिवडइ तुवरी वविज्जंती

english: Look! The landowner's son has already plucked the cotton But his simple wife lingers, vainly stroking the empty pods With a trembling and sweaty hand
prakrit: गहवइसुओच्चिएसु वि फलहीवेंटेसु उअह वहुआइ,मोहं भमइ पुलइओ विलग्गसेअंगुली हत्थो

english: When the plowman took to flight, Fearing the good lady was dead When she had only swooned in love's ecstasy, The cotton plant, bowed under its white, half-opened pods, Seemed to smile.
prakrit: अज्जं मोहणसुहिअं मुअ त्ति मोत्तुं पलाइए हलिए,दरफुडिअवेंटभारोणआइ हसिअं व फलहीए

english: Some lucky women are able to prance around With sighs and shivers and raptures. But when women like us see their husbands They completely forget themselves.
prakrit: णीसासुक्कंपिअपुलइएहि जाणंति णच्चिउं धण्णा,अम्हारिसीहि दिट्ठे पिअम्मि अप्पा वि वीसरिओ

english: Like being ill without a doctor, Like being poor amongst one's relatives, Like seeing one's enemy prosper, This separation from you is intolerable.
prakrit: वाहि व्व वेज्जरहिओ धणरहिओ सअणमज्झवासो व्व,रिउरिद्धिदंसणं मिव दूसहणीओ तुह विओओ

english: Listening for the rustle of dead leaves Stirred by his footfall, The wanton woman awaits her lover in the arbor
prakrit: आअण्णेइ अडअणा कुडुंगहेट्ठम्मि दिण्णसंकेआ,अग्गपअपेल्लिआणं मम्मरअं जुण्णपत्ताणं

english: Attracted by her fragrant breath, Bees cluster round her face That is like no other lotus Since the moon cannot outshine it
prakrit: अहिलेंति सुरहिणीससिअपरिमलावद्धमंडलं भमरा,अमुणिअचंदपरिहवं अपुव्वकमलं मुहं तिस्सा

english: In front of her parents She showed no emotion When you passed by, But a tear that clung to her lashes Fell when she closed her eyes.
prakrit: धीरावलंविरीअ वि गुरुअणपुरओ तुमम्मि वोलीणे,पडिओ से अच्छिणिमीलणेण पम्हट्ठिओ वाहो

english: I will never forget How at first she turned her back on me, Then, as her sulkiness faded, Heaved up her round breasts, While feigning sleep —What pleasure it was to fondle them.
prakrit: भरिमो से सअणपरंमुहीअ विअलंतमाणपसराइ,कइअवसुत्तुव्वत्तणथणअलसप्पेल्लणसुहेल्लिं

english: Why are you trying to wash away that powder Which someone innocently threw at you On the Holê festival? It has already been washed away by the sweat Streaming off the nipples of your round breasts.
prakrit: फग्गुच्छवणिद्दोसं केण वि कद्दमपसाहणं दिण्णं,थणअलसमुहपलोट्टंतसेअधोअं किणो धुअसि

english: You dimwit, What do you mean she didn't say anything to you? This village headman's daughter, Who in front of her elders looked at you With half-closed eyes and face slightly averted, Without blinking once.
prakrit: किं ण भणिओ सि वालअ गामणिधूआइ गुरुअणसमक्खं,अणिमिसम् ईसीसि वलंतवअणणअणद्धतिट्ठेहिं

english: You fool, How can you say she didn't say a word? She looked at you all the time But her sight was blurred By the tears welling up in her eyes
prakrit: णअणब्भंतरघोलंतवाहभरमंथराइ दिट्ठीए,पुणरुत्तपेच्छरीए वालअ किं जं ण भणिओ सि

english: In the house left empty by his wife's death The plowman is consumed by grief, Staring at where they used to make love As though at hiding places robbed of their treasure
prakrit: अंतोहुत्तं डज्झइ जाआसुण्णे घरे हलिअउत्तो,उक्खाअणिहाणाइ व रमिअट्ठाणाइ पेच्छंतो

english: If when he's away One lies awake, Grows pale, And sighs deeply, What is the point of being angry When he's back again?
prakrit: णिद्दाभंगो आवंडुरत्तणं दीहरा अ णीसासा,जाअंति जस्स विरहे तेण समं कीरिसो माणो

english: The only reason I do not die of anger This very moment, my dear, Is that in my next life I do not wish to be dependent on you again Because I died thinking of you.
prakrit: तेण ण मरामि मण्णूहि पूरिआ अज्ज जेण रे सुहअ,तग्गअमणा मरंती मा तुज्झ पुणो वि लग्गिस्सं

english: Do your worst, have no fear: I can take anything from you, my dear. In my heart, so brimful of your virtues, There is no room for any faults.
prakrit: अवरज्झसु वीसद्धं सव्वं ते सुहअ विसहिमो अम्हे,गुणणिब्भरम्मि हिअए पत्तिअ दोसा ण माअंति

english: The tear in the eye of the wretched girl, Betraying thoughts of her beloved, Wells up, brims over and flows out Like a flood of grief.
prakrit: भरिउच्चरंतपसरिअपिअसंभरणपिसुणो वराईए,परिवाहो विअ दुक्खस्स वहइ णअणट्ठिओ वाहो

english: Going over everything you do, Everything you say, Every trick of your eyes —One day is too short
prakrit: जं जं करेसि जं जं जंपसि जह जह तुमं णिअच्छेसि,तं तम् अणुसिक्खिरीए दीहो दिअहो ण संपडइ

english: The straw she had grudgingly given the traveler To sleep on, That same straw she was sweeping up next morning In tears.
prakrit: भंडंतीअ तणाइं सोत्तुं दिण्णाइ जाइ पहिअस्स,ताइ च्चेअ पहाए अज्जा आअड्ढइ रुअंती

english: Friend, Whoever it was who sang this song So early in the morning, He must have been thinking of some lover, For he reopened the wounds That the God of Love had made in my heart With his sharp arrows
prakrit: अज्ज सहि केण गोसे कं पि मणे वल्लहं भरंतेण,अम्हं मअणसराहअहिअअवणप्फोडणं गीअं

english: When she saw the high breasts Of her husband's new wife The first wife sighed And her face fell.
prakrit: उट्ठंतमहारंभे थणए दट्ठूण मुद्धवहुआए,ओसण्णकवोलाए णीससिअं पढमघरिणीए

english: Though tormented with hunger The elephant allows the tasty mouthful of lotus roots In his trunk To dry up and wither As he stands thinking of the face of his favorite wife
prakrit: गरुअछुहाउलिअस्स वि वल्लहकरिणीमुहं भरंतस्स,सरसो मुणालकवलो गअस्स हत्थे च्चिअ मिलाणो

english: Calm down. Who's the angry one? You, my slim beauty. How can one be angry with a stranger? Who's the stranger? You, my lord. How come? I must have done something wrong in a past life.
prakrit: पसिअ पिए का कुविआ सुअणु तुमं परअणम्मि को कोवो,को हु परो णाह तुमं कीस अउण्णाण मे सत्ती

english: Thinking that you would come, The wakeful first part of the night went by in a minute. The remainder of the night, Filled with disappointment, Seemed to last a year.
prakrit: एहिसि तुमं ति णिमिसं व जग्गिअं जामिणीअ पढमद्धं,सेसं संतावपरव्वसाइ वरिसं व वोलीणं

english: Catch her! No need to be afraid of this woman Running around in circles: She is not possessed by a demon, Just a traveler's wife Startled by a sudden thunderclap.
prakrit: अवलंवह मा संकह ण इमा गहलंघिआ परिब्भमइ,अत्थक्कगज्जिउब्भंतहित्थहिअआ पहिअजाआ

english: Bee, Only were you to find in another flower As much nectar as you find inside the pollen-filled lotus Would you be right to hover around it.
prakrit: केसररअविच्छड्डे मअरंदो होइ जेत्तिओ कमले,जइ भमर तेत्तिओ अण्णहिं पि ता सोहसि भमंतो

english: Full of desire, the passers-by halt And stare at the plowman's daughter Who is powdered with flour, Without blinking their eyes, As if they were the gods And she the goddess Laksm≥ ê Rising up from the Ocean of Milk.
prakrit: पेच्छंति अणिमिसच्छा पहिआ हलिअस्स पिट्ठपंडुरिअं,धूअं दुद्धसमुद्दुत्तरंतलच्छिं विअ सअण्हा

english: When we asked her whom she was thinking of She replied: "No one," And began to cry so piteously That we cried with her.
prakrit: कस्स भरसि त्ति भणिए को मे अत्थि त्ति जंपमाणीए,उव्विग्गरोइरीए अम्हे वि रुआविआ तीए

english: Be reasonable! Your husband has fallen at your feet. Why not help him up again? However long your love has lasted, This could be the end.
prakrit: पाअपडिअं अहव्वे किं दाणि ण उट्ठवेसि भत्तारं,एअं चिअ अवसाणं दूरं पि गअस्स पेम्मस्स

english: With fingertips clutching the river bank, And hips gently moving with the waves, The female frog, Hanging over her mirror image in the water, Looks like a woman making love On top of her husband.
prakrit: तडविणिहिअग्गहत्था वारितरंगेहि घोलिरणिअंवा,सालूरी पडिविंवे पुरिसाअंति व्व पडिहाइ

english: Thanks to you, prickly safflower tree, Young girls will learn to suck in their breath, To moan, To twitch, To flutter their hands And make their bracelets rattle.
prakrit: सिक्करिअमणिअमुहवेविआइ धुअहत्थसिंजिअव्वाइ,सिक्खंतु वोडहीओ कुसुंभ तुम्हं पसाएण

english: Why, my hips, Have you not grown as wide as the street So that I might touch that lovely man As he tries to escape The awkward scene with my parents?
prakrit: जेत्तिअमेत्ता रच्छा णिअंव कह तेत्तिओ ण जाओ सि,जेण छिविज्जइ गुरुअणलज्जोसरिओ वि सो सुहओ

english: In the rainy season The peacock, Stretching its long neck, Pecks at the raindrop That hangs on the tip of a grass blade Like a pearl pierced by an emerald needle
prakrit: मरगअसूईविद्धं व मोत्तिअं पिअइ आअअग्गीवो,मोरो पाउसआले तणग्गलग्गं उअअविंदुं

english: Her round breast Bulging out of a dark blue blouse Looks like the moon Peering from behind a cloud Heavy with rain.
prakrit: अज्जाइ णीलकंचुअभरिउव्वरिअं विहाइ थणवट्टं,जलभरिअजलहरंतरदरुग्गअं चंदविंवं व

english: Cautiously, As if it were a matter of high treason, One traveler said to the other: "There are shoots on the mango trees. So it can't be long now."
prakrit: राअविरुद्धं व कहं पहिओ पहिअस्स साहइ ससंकं,जत्तो अम्वाण दलं तत्तो दरणिग्गअं किं पि

english: Happy the women Who at least see their lovers in dream. But without him I cannot sleep Let alone dream.
prakrit: धण्णा ता महिलाओ जा दइअं सिविणए वि पेच्छंति,णिद्द च्चिअ तेण विणा ण एइ का पेच्छए सिविणं

english: In the midday heat of summer The mere thought of the refreshing stream of cool moonlight From his wife's round face Restores the traveler.
prakrit: मज्झण्हपत्थिअस्स वि गिम्हे पहिअस्स हरइ संतावं,हिअअट्ठिअजाआमुहमअंकजोण्हाजलप्पवहो

english: Tell me, Would you not get angry When bothered at the wrong time and place? What mother does not curse her little son, dear as he is, If he comes crying while she is busy making love?
prakrit: भण को ण रूसइ जणो पत्थिज्जंतो अदेसआलम्मि,रइवावडा रुवंतं पिअं पि पुत्तं सवइ माआ

english: O, aóoka tree, There is nothing more for you to achieve: Your leaves have been compared to the hand of a lovely woman
prakrit: एएण च्चिअ कंकेल्लि तुज्झ तं ण त्थि जं ण पज्जत्तं,उवमिज्जइ जं तुह पल्लवेण वरकामिणीहत्थो

english: Her body Sweating with the pleasure Of tightly embracing her beloved husband, The landowner's daughter Puts out the flames of his pyre
prakrit: विज्झाविज्जइ जलणो गहवइधूआइ वित्थअसिहो वि,अणुमरणघणालिंगणपिअअमसुहसिज्जिरंगीए

english: The kapalika novice cannot stop daubing her body With ashes that come from her lover's pyre: The pleasure of touching them Brings her out in a sweat.
prakrit: जारमसाणसमुब्भवभूइसुहप्फंससिज्जिरंगीए,ण समप्पइ णवकावालिणीअ उद्धूलणारंभो

english: One breast oozes milk, The other is covered with nail marks and gooseflesh: Behold the housewife sitting between husband and son.
prakrit: एक्को पण्हअइ थणो वीओ पुलएइ णहमुहालिहिओ,पुत्तस्स पिअअमस्स अ मज्झणिसण्णाइ घरिणीअ

english: Though still a child, The village headman's daughter Already turns everybody's head. Once she is grown up She will cause real harm, Like a poisonous creeper.
prakrit: एत्ताइ च्चिअ मोहं जणेइ वालत्तणे वि वट्टंती,गामणिधुआ विसलअ व्व वड्ढिआ काहिइ अणत्थं

english: "Go to sleep! It's past three o'clock!" Dear girls, how can you say that to me? The scent of jasmine makes sleep impossible. Try going to sleep yourselves.
prakrit: सुप्पउ तइओ वि गओ जामो त्ति सहीउ कीस मं भणह,सेहालिआण गंधो ण देइ सोत्तुं सुअह तुम्हे

english: How could I not remember that man Who even after it was over Looked at my limp body As if he felt like doing it again?
prakrit: कह सो ण संभरिज्जइ जो मे तह संठिआइ अंगाइं,णिव्वत्तिए वि सुरए णिज्झाअइ सुरअरसिओ व्व

english: Summer reveals what was never seen before: The bottom of the pond With turtles and minnows Struggling in the thick, dry mud and heat.
prakrit: सुक्खंतवहलकद्दमघम्मविसूरंतकमढपाढीणं,दिट्ठं अइट्ठउव्वं कालेण तलं तडाअस्स

english: She does not answer when spoken to And is cross with everyone For no other reason Than that the bush on the river bank is burning.
prakrit: वाहित्ता पडिवअणं ण देइ रूसेइ एक्कमेक्कस्स,असई कज्जेण विणा पलिप्पमाणे णईकच्छे

english: My dear, Only women who do not see you Stay happy: They sleep properly, Hear what is said to them, And do not muddle their words.
prakrit: णिद्दं लहंति कहिअं सुणंति खलिअक्खरं ण जंपंति,जाहि ण दिट्ठो सि तुमं ताओ च्चिअ सुहअ सुहिआओ

english: Delighted with the modest pair of berries you gave her, Your wife, though usually so shy, has gone home Down the center of the village street, Wearing them behind her ear.
prakrit: वालअ तुमाइ दिण्णं कण्णे काऊण वोरसंघाडिं,लज्जालुइणी वि वहू घरं गआ गामरच्छाए

english: When he ran out of the house, Dismayed at my rudely rejecting His attempt at reconciliation, You should have stopped him Instead of laughing at someone else's misfortune
prakrit: अह सो विलक्खहिअओ मए अहव्वाइ अगहिआणुणओ,परवज्जणच्चिरीहिं तुम्हेहि उवेक्खिओ णिंतो

english: Remember those vañjula trees on the riverbank Whose blossom was bowed by clusters of bees? Time, dear friend, has turned them to stumps.
prakrit: जे लीणभमरभरभग्गगोच्छआ आसि णइअडुच्छंगे,कालेण वंजुला पिअवअस्स ते खण्णुआ जाआ

english: Aunt, It pains me now to realize How fragile a thing love is, Like treasure beheld in a dream That vanishes in the light of day
prakrit: खणभंगुरेण पेम्मेण माउआ दूमिअ म्हि एत्ताहे,सिविणअणिहिलंभेण व दिट्ठपणट्ठेण लोअम्मि

english: The bow shoots the arrow The moment it touches the string. How long can straight and crooked stay together?
prakrit: चाओ सहावसरलं विच्छुहइ सरं गुणम्मि णिवडंतं,वंकस्स उज्जुअस्स अ संवंधो किं चिरं होइ

english: Don't think winter is content Merely to wither the summer jasmine. It also has to produce a mass Of worthless winter jasmine.
prakrit: मालइकुसुमाइ कुलुंचिऊण मा जाण णिव्वुओ सिसिरो,काअव्वा अज्ज वि णिग्गुणाण कुंदाण सामिद्धी

english: Who is not captivated by a woman's breasts, That, like a good poem, Are a pleasure to grasp, Are weighty, compact, and nicely ornamented?
prakrit: परिमलणसुहा गरुआ अलद्धविवरा सलक्खणाहरणा,थणआ कव्वालाअ व्व कस्स हिअए ण लग्गंति

english: In the act of embracing their lovers Young ladies toss the pearl necklaces From their round breasts. Even the praiseworthy Sometimes get treated with disrespect.
prakrit: खिप्पइ हारो थणमंडलाहि तरुणीहि रमणपरिरंभे,अच्चिअगुणा वि गुणिणो लहंति लहुअत्तणं काले

english: Friend, The wretched fire of love Is an odd sort of fire: In a sapless heart it goes out, In a sappy one it instantly flares up
prakrit: अण्णो को वि सहावो वम्महसिहिणो हला हआसस्स,विज्झाइ णीरसाणं हिअए सरसाण पज्जलइ

english: Aunt, When the tree of love, Rooted in long affection, Is struck by the axe of pride It falls without a sound.
prakrit: तह तस्स माणपरिवड्ढिअस्स चिरपणअवद्धमूलस्स,मामि पडंतस्स सुओ सद्दो वि ण पेम्मरुक्खस्स

english: When he spoke affectionately You answered curtly, When he went away You did not try to stop him. Tell me, What exactly do you hope to gain By your pride?
prakrit: पाअपडिओ ण गणिओ पिअं भणंतो वि अप्पिअं भणिओ,वच्चंतो वि ण रुद्धो भण कस्स कए कओ माणो

english: One moment she tried wiping, The next scrubbing, And after that rubbing. The young wife was completely at a loss What to do with the nail mark Her husband had left on her breast
prakrit: पुसइ खणं धुअइ खणं पप्फोडइ तक्खणं अआणंती,मुद्धवहू थणवट्टे दिण्णं दइएण णक्खवअं

english: After the rainy season With towering clouds, Like youth with plump breasts, Has spent itself, Plumes of kasa grass, Like the first strands of gray hair, Appear on Mother Earth.
prakrit: वासारत्ते उण्णअपओहरे जोव्वणे व्व वोलीणे,पढमेक्ककासकुसुमं दीसइ पलिअं व धरणीए

english: Hear how that cloud groans with the effort, Yet is unable to lift the earth With ropes of raindrops That fall in unbroken streams
prakrit: अविरलपडंतणवजलधारारज्जुघडिअं पअत्तेण,अपहुत्तो उक्खिविउं रसइ व मेहो महिं उअह

english: Heart, At the time When my lover mentioned the date of his return You did not object. So what are you doing now Destroying our belief in his early arrival?
prakrit: ओ हिअअ ओहिदिअहं तइआ पडिवज्जिऊण दइअस्स,अत्थक्काउल वीसंभघाइ किं तइ समाढत्तं

english: Even to someone who knows nothing about it She tells who it is who has broken her bracelets. Either the poor girl is naïve Or she really loves the man who has made her so unhappy.
prakrit: जो वि ण आणइ तस्स वि कहेइ भग्गाइ तेण वलआइं,अइउज्जुआ वराई अहव पिओ से हआसाए

english: Sweating all over From just mentioning her lover's name, She was so busy instructing the messenger That she did not notice They had arrived in front of his house.
prakrit: सेउल्लिअसव्वंगी गोत्तग्गहणेण तस्स सुहअस्स,दूइं अप्पाहेंती तस्सेअ घरंगणं पत्ता

english: Even in my next existence, O God of Love, I will dedicate my life In worship at your feet, If you promise to pierce him With the same arrow As you pierced me with
prakrit: जम्मंतरे वि चलणे जीएणं मअण तुज्झ अच्चिस्सं,जइ तं पि तेण वाणेण विज्झसे जेण हं विद्धा

english: O bee, To get at the jasmine's nectar You have to knead and squeeze long and hard. It does not open by itself.
prakrit: जाव ण कोसविआसं पावइ ईसीसि मालईकलिआ,मअरंदपाणलोहिल्ल भमर ताव च्चिअ मलेसि

english: Even now I can see The mud in that wretched village, Which I squelched through on those dark nights In the rainy season Just to please you. And what did I get out of it, You shameless man?
prakrit: अकअण्णुअ तुज्झ कए पाउसराईसु जं मए खुण्णं,उप्पेक्खामि अलज्जिर अज्ज वि तं गामचिक्खिल्लं

english: The girl on top of her lover, Her hair hanging loose, Her earrings swinging And her pearl necklace hovering, Looks just like a vidyadhare Who is about to fly away
prakrit: रेहइ गलंतकेसक्खलंतकुंडलललंतहारलआ,अद्धुप्पइआ विज्जाहरि व्व पुरिसाइरी वाला

english: All the village headman's wives Are dressed in readiness to follow him on the pyre, Yet even at this heartrending moment His eyes fall upon his favorite.
prakrit: गामणिणो सव्वासु वि पिआसु अणुमरणगहिअवेसासु,मम्मच्छेएसु वि वल्लहाइ उवरिं वलइ दिट्ठी

english: Aunt, The words may be the same But they sound quite different Depending on whether they are said with affection Or with reserve
prakrit: मामि सरिसक्खराण वि अत्थि विसेसो पअंपिअव्वाणं,णेहमइआणम् अण्णो अण्णो उवरोहमइआणं

english: Words which come from the heart Sound different. Get away with you! I've no time for words That pay mere lip service.
prakrit: हिअआहिंतो पसरंति जाइ अण्णाइ ताइ वअणाइ,ओसरसु किं इमेहिं अहरंतरमेत्तभणिएहिं

english: Have you no feelings? How can she enjoy your favor At the same time as me When you rob her of her name And give it to me?
prakrit: कह सा सोहग्गगुणं मए समं वहइ णिग्घिण तुमम्मि,जीअ हरिज्जइ णामं हरिऊण अ दिज्जए मज्झ

english: Friend, tell me honestly, I beg of you, Is it the case with all women That the bracelets grow larger on their wrists When their husband is away
prakrit: सहि साहसु सब्भावेण पुच्छिमो किं असेसमहिलाणं,वड्ढंति करत्थ च्चिअ वलआ दइए पउत्थम्मि

english: Fettered by affection The she-elephant circles around in distress And stretches out her trunk to rescue Her husband who is stuck in the mud.
prakrit: भमइ परिदो विसूरइ उक्खिविउं से करं पसारेइ,करिणो पंकक्खुत्तस्स णेहणिअलाविआ करिणी

english: Long live Siva's third eye : Which Paravati covered with kisses While covering his other two eyes with her hands When her skirt slipped off in the heat of love play
prakrit: रइकेलिहिअणिअंसणकरकिसलअरुद्धणअणजुअलस्स,रुद्दस्स तइअणअणं पव्वइपरिउंविअं जअइ

english: As soon as you have a supple twig in your hand She runs across your path, Hovers on either side of you, And happens to be Wherever you are looking. You blockhead, Can't you see the poor girl Desperately wants a good thrashing?

english: When her relatives whirled around the sheet Said to be stained with the young bride's blood The virgin's lover looked on with a glint in his eye.
